Name: Mal's Sebastian Expansion with Post Marriage Events
Author: st1v3rs0n
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Mal's Sebastian Expansion 
[/b][/size][b][size=3]Works with Content Patcher, improves Character Development, and provides a m[/size][size=3]ore immersive gameplay![/size][/b][/center]
[center]I was largely disappointed with how bland the game got character-wise after you plowed through all of the existing character development the game had to offer.  Marriage was also exceedingly boring since the spouse said the same repetitive things.  To make it worse, the best part--events--were no where to be found!

I aimed to remedy this by creating this mega mod that's an all-in-one fix and expansion into Sebastian's character--pre- and post-marriage!

First, I want to say I was very much inspired by 10kCats' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2008]Marriage Events for Shane.[/url]﻿ If you're into Shane, you should totally check it out! But my hubby is Seb, so I wanted to give him some love, too!
[size=4]
[/size][b][size=4][/size][/b][url=https://tieba.baidu.com/p/5887995495?pid=122086212080&cid=0&red_tag=1887325328#122086212080][size=4]Chinese Translation by Erinyang![/size]
[/url][size=4][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/mals-sebastian-expansion-with-post-marriage-events-pt-br-translation-smoking-version.5847/]Brazilian Portuguese Translation by Mdscatharina﻿!
[/url][b][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12698][b]﻿日本語 Japanese [/b][b]Translation by Rubisco23![/b]
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4612]﻿﻿﻿﻿Portuguese Translation by Analiviaxz!
[/url][b][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5899]﻿Russian Translation by Sergx59!
[/url][b][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7689][b]﻿[/b][b]Spanish Translation by Lialeian!
[/b][/url]﻿[b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Non-smoking version is now released! [/b]
[/size][size=2]Please note: this includes changes to his dialogue and sprite![i] [/i]Thank you to Prismuth for letting me use their awesome[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1643] non-smoking Seb sprite[/url]﻿!

[/size][/center][center][/center][center][b]How to Install:
[/b]1. Have Content Patcher Installed
2. Unzip Mal's Seb Expansion Mod into your Mods folder
3. You're good to go!
[/center][center][/center][center][size=4][b]New Dialogue Lines (Pre-﻿ and Post-Marriage)
[/b][/size][/center][center][size=2]I've added 40+ New dialogue lines for Sebastian Pre-marriage, as well as 20 lines of dialogue for post-marriage.  Bonus: pre-marriage, Seb will occasionally send you mail.
[/size][/center][center][size=4][b]Select Villagers Reference your Marital Status 
[/b][/size][/center][center][size=2]Once you tie the knot, ﻿certain villagers (you can find out for yourselves!) will all reference your marital status with Seb on certain days of the week.

[/size][/center][center][size=4][b]7 New Post-Marriage Events![/b][/size][/center][size=4][b]First Event[/b]: [/size]The first event of a 4-event series dives into the absence of Seb's dad, and how that impacted his personality growing up. It explains more about why Seb was so drawn to the city at one point, and ends on a sweet note.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YuGKth8.png[/img]﻿

[size=4][b]Second Event:[/b][/size][size=2] This one can be seen after viewing the previous event.  Sebastian laments his failed relationships and tries to fire himself up to do something about them.  Includes forked dialogue! You'll get some new insight into Seb's character!

[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/Tn1GOZ0.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Third Event:[/b] [/size]Sebastian wants to tell you how much your advice helped and what the outcome was!  You'll need to upgrade your farmhouse and then go into your Mal's Sebastian Expansion Mod folder and edit the config file to read "true"

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6l1hk8I.png[/img]﻿

[size=4][b]Fourth Event: [/b][/size]Robin thanks you for all that you've done for her dear Sebby!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ql5PXxG.png[/img]﻿

[b][size=4]Fifth Event: [/size][/b][size=2]Go stargazing with Seb and Maru! 
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/29pnAgf.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Sixth Event:[/b] [/size][size=2]Revisit the beach on a rainy day!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e7LfCQt.png[/img][/size]

[size=4][b]Seventh Event:[/b][/size] [size=2]After getting your second house upgrade (the one allowing you to have kids), edit the config file to "true" and that will allow this cute event to trigger. A cute scene in bed with Seb! Inspired by the pillow talk event in 10kcats' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2008?tab=description]Marriage Events for Shane[/url].
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RmtnNYz.png[/img]﻿

[b]How to trigger events:
ALL OF THESE EVENTS WILL ONLY OCCUR ONCE MARRIED
[/b]*Event 1: Have Seb at 11 hearts. On a monday, enter the mountains between 10:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m.
*Event 2: Have Seb at 11 hearts. On a friday, enter the ocean map between 10:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. You must have seen event 1.
*Event 3: You must have the 2nd house upgrade and you must edit the config file to read "true." It must be a tuesday and Seb must have 12 hearts.  Enter the farmhouse between 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. You must have seen Event 2.
*Event 4:  Requires you to enter Robin's shop while raining between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.  You must have Robin at 4 hearts. You need to have seen event 3.
*Event 5: Enter the mountain map in winter after seeing the 4th event.  Must be between 10:00 p.m. and 11:50 p.m.  Must have Maru at 4 hearts.
*Event 6: Can be seen after seeing Event 4.  Seb must have 12 hearts. Enter the beach on a rainy day between 10:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m.
*Event 7: You must set the config file to read "true" after having the 2nd house upgrade. Seb must have 12 hearts.  Enter your house between 10:00 p.m. and 11:50 p.m.
[i]***Events 2 through 6 have pre-requisite events.
[/i]
[b]Credit and Thanks:[/b]
Thanks to Prismuth for letting me use their awesome [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1643]Non-Smoking Sebastian Sprite[/url]!
Thanks to tenthousandcats for inspiring me to make post-marriage events! (And allowing me to do a late night event with Seb at the farmhouse).  Thanks for your encouragement and inspiration!
Thanks to 31fr4g3 for helping me edit the dialogue for a few events!
Thanks to pathoschild and all of the SDV discord for being helpful with troubleshooting! 
Thanks to Erinyang for translating the mod into Chinese!

[b]Note:[/b]
I'm super new to this, but let me know if you want me to expand further upon marriage life with Seb.  I have some other event ideas I have yet to implement.  Or if you have any helpful tips, tricks, or criticism, let me know.
